text: Move Ablative Armor Layer from TL1 to TL2 so the base TL1 Auxiliary catalog remains compact and easier to learn.
Use AP0 / AI2 as the leading TL2 Ablative entry candidate; compare AP0 / AI3 and AP1 / AI1 while retaining AP1 / AI2 only as the Checkpoint 52 historical control.
Keep AMM ammunition at 25 rounds at both TL1 and TL2 for now; retain 1 TP readiness and the current accuracy progression.

Combat Battery provides three finite +1 TP charges. At most one charge may discharge per tactical turn, but there is no per-encounter cap; a prolonged fight may consume all three charges over three turns.
Combat Battery charges persist after use until a valid replenishment opportunity; do not auto-refill between ordinary tactical encounters.
Power Capacitor remains TL2 and shifts, rather than generates, Tactical Power: +1 TP discharge followed by a later-turn 1 TP recharge; no same-turn charge/discharge.
Use a separate common sustained-Tactical-Power-load diagnostic to evaluate Battery/Capacitor role expression. This diagnostic does not establish a new universal hotel-load rule.
Preserve Checkpoint 52 as frozen regression evidence and defer TL3 runtime generation until the TL2 Ablative candidate and power-stress review are accepted.
